{{Top}}
A '''ship of the line''' was a term for a heavy [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]],<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]],<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].<ref name="SW47">[[Star Wars (1977) 47|''Star Wars'' (1977) 47]]</ref>

==History==
Heavier [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] and [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] in the Republic Navy were often termed ships of the line when part of the naval unit known as a "[[section]]." The section in turn was called a "line" when encompassing groups of heavier warships.<ref name="TCWCG" />

In the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], the individual [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] were made into lines by themselves.<ref name="ISB" />

In the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], ships of the line included a [[Rebel ship of the line|type of vessel]] similar to a [[Luke Skywalker's scout craft]], but larger.<ref name="SW47" />
